messages:
mina: Heads-up from support: customers keep seeing only gateway key in the console. They want per-project provenance but dashboards spike when we try to show identities.
raul: We can't use full identity strings in metrics (PII + cardinality). Proposal: emit compact provenance tokens for sampled events (HMAC prefix), plus aggregated counters per (origin_key, route).
harry: Agreed. Implementation idea: hybrid sampler at the ingress producer: keep first K events/day per key, then probabilistic sample after. Store ef_hash = hex(HMAC_SHA256(eff_identity, telemetry_key))[0:12] so we never persist raw IDs.
mina: UX side — avoid new heavy filters. Add a small "provenance examples" panel on the key page showing eff_hash + route + reason + timestamp (sampled). And a short tooltip: "These examples are sampled; billing uses canonical counters."
raul: Important: enforcement path must remain authoritative and fast. Add a CI gate asserting sampled pipeline is not used by quota/enforcer paths. Sampled data is read-only for observability.
harry: Rollout plan: stage 0 staging with top 5k keys, retention 30d. stage 1 expand to 25k if cost delta < 12%. Also LRU cap on eff_hash index to bound cardinality.
mina: Ops note: include routing metadata (route_id, model_variant, fallback) in sample so SRE can triage latency/fallback incidents.
raul: Also provide an org-level opt-in toggle: "Include delegated provenance details in UI (may increase storage costs)" default off. When off, UI shows counts and anonymized samples only.
ops-bot: deploy started: provenance-sampler@staging -> v0.2.0 by ci/cd at 2026-03-23T14:02:01Z
mina: Action items: raul implement sampler + eff_hash lib (PR by Wed), harry mock panel + tooltip, i'll coordinate billing signoff on retention.
harry: I'll add the CI assertion and a short FAQ blurb explaining differences between console metrics and billing exports.
mina: Great. Keep global sampling <1% for hot keys but ensure at-least-5/day for low-volume keys so owners see activity. Drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
